name: Clergy Housing Allowance Worksheet
meta_description: Work out how much of a minister’s housing allowance or parsonage is tax-free under IRC 107, the excess to report, and the self-employment tax impact.
subtitle: Find how much of a minister’s housing allowance is tax-free: the smallest of the designated allowance, actual housing costs, and the fair rental value of the home furnished plus utilities. It also shows the excess to report and the housing amount still subject to self-employment tax.

The limits on your exclusion
LimitAmount

Rules from IRS Publication 517 and Internal Revenue Code section 107. The exclusion also can’t exceed reasonable pay for your services, and the church must designate the amount before paying it. Mortgage interest and property taxes can still be itemized on Schedule A. This worksheet is an estimate, not tax advice.
